issues.evidence: Fresh FP-13 EXPLORER probe shows native C++ returns false for `decObjA ~ decObjB` where decObjA.value is 1.24 and decObjB.value is 1.2; forced Python fallback returns true. Spec requires complex equivalence to compare child properties recursively, and Decimal equivalence compares values rounded to the least precise operand, so 1.24 ~ 1.2 is true.
issues.root_cause: Native `jsonValuesEquivalent()` compared nested JSON numeric children using exact numeric equality instead of FHIRPath Decimal equivalence semantics during recursive complex equivalence.
issues.resolution: Added native semantic JSON complex recursion that applies Decimal equivalence to nested numeric children.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §6.1.1 Equals and §6.1.2 Equivalent
issues.evidence: Fresh FP-13 EXPLORER probe shows both native C++ and forced Python fallback return false for `rangeA = rangeB` and `rangeA ~ rangeB` when the only child `high` is a Quantity of 1 cm versus 10 mm, even though `rangeA.high = rangeB.high` and `rangeA.high ~ rangeB.high` return true. Spec requires complex equality/equivalence to compare child properties recursively, and Quantity equality/equivalence allows unit conversion for same-dimension quantities.
issues.root_cause: Complex equality/equivalence recursed through raw dict/JsonVal children without materializing nested Quantity-shaped child values, so parent objects did not inherit the same Quantity semantics as direct child comparisons.
issues.resolution: Routed Python complex equality/equivalence through recursive FHIRPath child semantics and added native semantic JSON equality/equivalence recursion with nested Quantity materialization.
issues.verified_in: FP-13 EXPLORER probe 54 cases/0 mismatches/0 failures; test_equality_parity.py 9 passed; native fhirpath sqllogictest 558 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822
